approach: Static ARMv7 to x86-64 translation to C, native MinGW build, OpenGL ES 1.x host layer.
notes: Static ARM-to-C recompilation of the Android build. One setup builds the game from the user's own legally owned copy for 3.2.4, 3.3.7 or 3.4.1 on Windows x64. The first-run installer downloads the official Gameloft data pack. No game files are distributed.
